velocity_reference: Native MuJoCo mj_objectVelocity, mjOBJ_BODY, world orientation: body inertial COM linear velocity and angular velocity. Does not use the MetaSim packed velocity fields.
observation_sampling: Post-action, every 15 ms; consecutive first-to-last span must be at least 2 seconds. Does not assert substep continuity.
original_score: Keep the original stop-on-first-geometric-success 50-rollout results. Also report SuccessOnce from the continued-rollout run separately.
rng_rule: Snapshot Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG at first geometric success and restore after continuation, preserving the next episode RNG stream of official early-stop evaluation.
interpretation: An explicitly defined supplemental stability metric, not the original task criterion. No intervention releases the object. Thresholds are not tuned to attain a target score.
